Abilities:
Boss Shield:
Cannot take more than 1 damage from a single attack in Phase 1.
Damage Shield:
Damage over 125,000 dealt to Gramiel is reduced by raising the difference to the exponent 0.8 (but is never reduced below 125,000) in Phase 2.
Crystal Shattered:
When a Grace Crystal is destroyed, applies Crystal Shattered to Gramiel which is used for Gramiel's Crystal Meltdown in Phase 1.
Grace Claimed:
When a player dies while fighting Gramiel, he recovers 750,000 HP, and increasing 20% Outgoing Damage and Outgoing Physical Damage, accompanied by the message “In the end, you were nothing but a monster.”
Cannot be stunned.
Base Stats:
0% Crit Chance
0% Dodge
100% Damage Resistance
100% DoT Resistance
20% Outgoing Damage

20% Outgoing Magical Damage
